answer: Attention decay ledger.** Each identity accrues standing only through continuous, verifiable task participation; idle time erodes it along a decay curve, so a cluster of fresh identities sits at the glacier edge of eligibility, unable to act until it has logged sustained real work. Enrollment caps early weight at the curve's zenith, preventing burst registration from front-loading influence. A ripple of small, spaced contributions cannot be batched, because the ledger rejects compressed activity windows and cross-checks timing against independent task logs.
